protected_patterns.message: Use update-loop-state.sh to update state fields. Do NOT edit this file directly.
AGENTS.md is a symlink to CLAUDE.md. Use update-loop-state.sh to update state fields. Do NOT edit this file directly.
Experiment indices are append-only TSV files managed by exp-index.sh. Use the tool to add rows — do not edit directly.
Goal state files are managed by update-loop-state.sh. Do not edit directly.
prepare.py is FROZEN for fair comparison — it holds the fixed time budget and the ground-truth Eval.evaluate() harness. Only train.py may be modified. See TASK.md.
